ImageDescription.value:
I opened up my Custom Goldie (Coldie.. :P) bait to check if she really was Goldie as I was told.

See the scalp is not neatly cut, but that wasn't me. I would never do that to a dolly! I found some black hair remains. A very stretched spring. A little bit of orange yellow paint on the inside of the back plate. None on the face plate. Eyeballs are BL. So, my conclusion is.. it's highly likely she is Goldie... :) Those eyechips will go to the bin... Check out the re-root :D I'm afraid I will have to change that too. I do like the hair though. It's got several shades mixed in: pale pink, beige and light brown.. But I just can't be happy knowing she's been re-rooted like this.. no.

She is staying with me, but I still don't know what to do with her :)
